description: CMOS 14-stage ripple-carry binary counter/divider with an on-chip oscillator that can be set up for an RC or crystal. It runs from 3 V to 18 V (20 V rating) and has buffered, Schmitt-triggered inputs. A high level on RESET clears all stages and disables the oscillator.

groups.description: VDD positive supply, 3 V to 18 V recommended (20 V absolute maximum). Decouple close to pin 16.
groups.name: POWER

groups.description: VSS supply return / 0 V reference on pin 8.
groups.name: GROUND

groups.description: On-chip oscillator pins: φI is the input (pin 11), φO-bar is the inverted output (pin 10) and φO is the output (pin 9). Use them with an external RC network (Rx, Cx, Rs) or a crystal, or drive φI from an external clock. RC operation is not recommended below 7 V when Rx < 50 kΩ.
groups.name: TIMING

groups.description: The active-high RESET input clears the 14-stage counter and stops the oscillator. Its Schmitt-trigger input allows unlimited rise and fall times.
groups.name: CONTROL

groups.description: Buffered binary counter outputs Q4–Q10 and Q12–Q14 give the input frequency divided by 2^n. Q1–Q3 and Q11 are not brought out to pins.
groups.name: OTHER

pins.description: Buffered counter output, stage 12 (input frequency ÷4096). Standard B-series output drive: IOL min 0.51 mA at VO=0.4 V, VDD=5 V (25 °C).
pins.name: Q12

pins.description: Buffered counter output, stage 4 (input frequency ÷16). This is the first stage brought out to a pin; stages 1–3, 11 are internal only.
pins.name: Q4

pins.description: Oscillator output φO (non-inverted). Connect Cx here for RC operation. Drive current at VDD=5 V: IOL min 0.16 mA at VO=0.4 V. Fosc max 650 kHz typ at 10 V and 800 kHz typ at 15 V (Rx=5 kΩ, Cx=15 pF).
pins.name: PHI_O

pins.description: Inverted oscillator output φO-bar. Connect Rx here for RC operation, or the feedback resistor/crystal for crystal operation.
pins.name: ~{PHI_O}

pins.description: Clock/oscillator input φI with a Schmitt trigger. The counter advances on each negative-going edge. External clock up to 3.5/8/12 MHz min at VDD = 5/10/15 V. For RC operation, connect Rs (2Rx to 10Rx) from here to the Rx/Cx node.
pins.name: PHI_I

pins.description: Active-high asynchronous reset. Clears all counter stages to 0 and disables the oscillator. Minimum pulse width 120/60/40 ns at VDD = 5/10/15 V.
pins.name: RESET

pins.description: Positive supply. Recommended range is 3 V to 18 V; absolute maximum is -0.5 V to +20 V. Quiescent current max 5 µA at 5 V (25 °C).
pins.name: VDD
